unit: ERA5-Land grid cell and UTC feature day
target: At least one eligible VIIRS detection on the next UTC day
rationale: Preserve the supplier's pre-existing future test period. Remove the final seven feature days of each development partition before any model fitting. Do not move boundaries in response to model scores.
holdout_policy: Keep all final-test rows outside development loaders. No test label summaries, plots, predictions, calibration, threshold selection or scores during development.
prior_information: The supplied README and team specification already disclosed aggregate label counts and season-level information. This is a protected retrospective temporal holdout, not a double-blind or previously unseen-season experiment.
availability_assumption: Predict after the full UTC feature day has ended. ERA5-Land and the satellite archive support retrospective analysis; their real-world publication latency is not reproduced.

evaluation_plan.primary_metric: Average precision (AP); do not silently substitute trapezoidal PR-AUC
evaluation_plan.probability_output: 100 * P(next-day eligible detection), with probability reliability checked separately
evaluation_plan.calibration_and_thresholds: Use development data only. Define an out-of-sample calibration and threshold procedure before fitting a calibrator. Never use final-test labels.
evaluation_plan.current_fire_comparison: Compare conditions-only and full features. Evaluate the subset with fire_today = 0, retaining both positive and negative outcomes. A newly detected cell-day is not a confirmed new ignition.
evaluation_plan.final_test_release: Freeze preprocessing, features, model parameters, calibrator and threshold before the first test evaluation. Any later changes require a new independent evaluation, not another claim of blind performance.
